title: Version service project registry
description: The projects the version service tracks. Editors use this schema; loadProjects() in src/projects.ts is the check that counts, and CI runs it.

id.description: Permanent: the URL segment, the D1 key and the version_project metric tag. Unique.

pattern.description: A JavaScript regex anchored with ^ and $ that captures the version in a group named "version". Tags it doesn't match are ignored.

scheme.description: How the version is parsed and ordered. semver: strict semver. dotted: one to four numeric components, optionally followed by a -prerelease.

channels.description: Channel name -> the prerelease labels it serves on top of every stable release. A label is the leading letters of the first prerelease identifier, lowercased (rc.2 and rc1 are both rc). "*" admits every prerelease.

defaultChannel.description: The channel served when a request names none. Must be one of the channels.

clientIdentity.description: Tag request metrics with client IPs and user agents. A privacy and cardinality decision; tests allowlist the projects that may set it.

serverUserAgentPrefix.description: The user agent prefix the project's servers send, followed by their version.

examples.description: Real tags and what they must normalize to, or null for a tag the project ignores. Tests check every one.

repoId.description: GitHub's repository id (gh api repos/OWNER/NAME --jq .id), which survives renames and transfers.
